provenance.review: Host-free source and published-metadata review of v18.14.0...v18.14.2 for issue #123. Both tagged Git trees were compared locally; all 394 comparison commits were enumerated through four API pages (100/100/100/94), and the uncapped tree diff contains 421 paths. No client executable, semantic rehearsal, server, GPU or acceptance driver was run. Product CI is reported by the review pull request, not claimed by this source receipt.

client_upgrade.reason: Prepare a client-only v0.16.1 after v0.16.0 is published, retaining every v0.16.0 runtime, model and serving profile. Adopt the loop-guard false-positive fix and refusal of incomplete summaries together; never adopt 18.14.1 alone. The latest-release endpoint, ten-release census and ten-tag census still identify v18.14.2 as the newest stable release on the review date. This receipt does not stage the successor or authorize a window or publication.

behavior_review.predicate: 883431d5 replaces isLoopGuardedModel with loopGuardLevel and resolves thinking-loop-guard from catalog policy on every host: Claude off, Gemini/DeepSeek/Grok semantic, unassigned models exact. Qwen and opaque local aliases have no off/semantic assignment. PI_NO_THINKING_LOOP_GUARD=1 or loopGuard.enabled=false still explicitly disables it. A short exact cycle containing a newline now needs at least 1024 repeated characters instead of 180; its four-repeat count remains. Non-newline short cycles retain four repeats/180 characters; long cycles retain three repeats/1024 characters.
behavior_review.lane_effect: All NInfer routes retain exact detection, including preserved-thinking custom Responses streams, but repeated status lines below the new floor no longer discard a turn. Both reasoning and visible assistant text are guarded by default. This reduces a false-positive class without proving Qwen long-loop behavior on the real runtime.
behavior_review.action: Keep the guard enabled. Preregister short repeated-status-line success, sufficiently long exact-loop failure, non-newline stutter and continued tool/nonce success for q38-ninfer and qwen3.8-27b. Do not import predecessor long-loop or inference qualification.

behavior_review.predicate: bc8a9b2d, merged as cc3e8d57, rejects stopReason=length for local main summaries, turn-prefix summaries, handoffs and branch summaries; an incomplete display-only short summary is omitted without discarding a completed full summary. The budget/threshold functions are unchanged: at window 131072, reserve=max(floor(0.15*window),16384)=19660 and automatic compaction triggers strictly above 111412. Local main-summary output is separately bounded by min(floor(0.8*reserve),16384), not automatically the route's 32768 maximum output limit.
behavior_review.lane_effect: A real local summary hitting its output budget now fails visibly rather than being accepted as complete context. Numeric trigger and runtime configuration do not change. Queueable /compact also ships in 18.14.1; it changes scheduling when deliberately queued, not that boundary.
behavior_review.action: Preregister main/turn-prefix/handoff/branch length-stop rejection, completed-main plus truncated-short success, transcript preservation and successful later continuation on the NInfer lanes. Keep normal threshold, output limits and assertions unchanged; never mark an uninduced length stop as a passed negative probe.
